description: HammingNN.topK tie-break by row_id ascending. Equal-distance candidates must appear in ascending row_id order in the output. Pins the MX-Tidy fix (2026-06-05).
note: row_id values 1..5 map to Swift UUIDs with last byte = n (00000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000NN). String-ascending order matches numeric order for these IDs.
